5-6: A percentage of a quantity: the part as a number.
What percentage one amount is of another.
A percentage of the marbles in a bag after more are added.
Percentages of guests that make up all but a few: the number of guests.
A price raised by a percentage and then lowered by the same percentage.
A price after a discount: the price before it.
A percentage of a percentage: the part of the whole.
One amount more than another by a percentage: by what percentage the other is less.
A percentage that changes after some are taken away: the amount at the start.
Two discounts one after the other, against one larger discount.
